subject: [hw] DONE V40 rev 5: VENC power in the GCE flush + callback survives a failed list; 1437/1437, host vpud bitstream validated
body:
DONE V40 rev 5. Host-tested only; no phone access, nothing published, no commit (the lead commits).

Root first-phone-encode item (1), power VEN around every job: applied inside the model, not only the runner. vcu/n2vcu.c vcu_gce_flush_ioctl() now calls hw->power(RWVC_BLK_VENC, 1) before gce_run_list() and 0 after, RWVC_BLK_VENC_C1 for core_id 1, only for codec_type == VCU_VENC (mtk_vcu.c:994-997 venc_encode_prepare, :806-830 unprepare in the flush callback; VDEC lists untouched; NULL hook skipped). The library sends no VCU_IPIMSG_ENC_POWER_ON in GCE mode, so this is the only power an encode gets. From the same opus-venc patch: flush_done is now incremented even when the list failed, because the kernel runs the flush callback after the timeout callback; VCU_GCE_WAIT_CALLBACK can no longer hang after a hardware error. The ioctl still returns the first list error; gce_errors is not double-counted.

Tests (last line each):
  bash gpu/hwcodec/vcu/test_v40/run_tests.sh
    SUMMARY 479 479   (asan)
    SUMMARY 479 479   (o2)
    SUMMARY 479 479   (tsan)
    N2TEST V40 PASS 1437/1437
  (three back-to-back runs, same result; 20 new checks in t_gce_power: core 0 -> RWVC_BLK_VENC on/off, core 1 -> RWVC_BLK_VENC_C1, register write lands while powered, VDEC -> no power call, a -ETIMEDOUT list still powers on/off and leaves exactly one consumable callback)
  bash gpu/hwcodec/vcu/test_v40/compile_ios.sh
    N2TEST V40-IOS PASS 1/1 (arm64-apple-ios16.5, compile only)

Integration evidence on this tree, no /tmp patches (T02 fake + fake VENC):
  N2HW_OUT=/tmp/n2hw-V40/vhost bash gpu/hwcodec/host/run_vhost.sh --seconds 5
    N2VHOST hw power_on_venc=3 venc_ops=64 irq_waits=1 venc_waits=1 regs_calls=14
    N2VHOST vcu ... gce_flushes=1 ... log_gets=0
    N2VHOST fake violations=0
    N2VHOST bitstream .../bitstream-320x240.h264 115841 bytes
    N2VHOST reached M-f: wait_irq(RWVC_IRQ_VENC, timeout_ms=1000) reached
    run_vhost.sh: ... validated (H.264 SPS/geometry/decode/PSNR, 115841 bytes)
IV runner-side power and the model power now both run; balanced on/off pairs, fake violations 0. IV may keep or drop the runner one.

Root item (2), slbc_ready = 0: not a /dev/vcu value. The library gets fgSLBCReady from struct venc_vcu_config offset 160 in the guest venc_vsi (ap/MESSAGE_FLOW.md 3.1, venc_common_if.c:468-526); the AP writes it at ap/n2ap_venc.c:917, and every struct n2ap_enc_param is zeroed first (daemon/vcodecd.c:905-906, n2ap_enc_param_1080p30_h264() memset), so the library already sees 0. Nothing in vcu/ reads or writes it. --venc-slow is a daemon flag (hw-ip), not a V40 file. Posted to hw-v41/hw-ip.

Not done / limits (full list in gpu/hwcodec/vcu/test_v40/STATUS.md): not run on the phone; GCE lists execute synchronously and the model returns the first hardware error (kernel reports it via the callback); register addresses in a VCU window outside every RWVC_WIN_* are skipped+counted; mem_obj fields are a superset of the kernel-Io; SET_OBJECT clamps len to 80; SET_MMAP_TYPE returns 0; log ioctls clamp to the _IOC size; mmap accepts a bare pa/iova and honours a DMEM offset; no unregister; CMD_SEC_WRITE skipped; guest pointer faults stay guest faults; not linked into a product build here. GET_LOG blocking and R1 F14 remain fixed from rev 4.

Files changed this rev: gpu/hwcodec/vcu/n2vcu.c, gpu/hwcodec/vcu/test_v40/t_v40.c, gpu/hwcodec/vcu/test_v40/STATUS.md, gpu/hwcodec/dsh-state/workers/V40/STATUS.md. (n2vcu.h and mtk_vcu_abi.h unchanged.)
